SELECT
    CASE WHEN now() - "time" > interval '30 seconds' THEN 'Нет данных'
         WHEN valid = false THEN COALESCE(measurement_error_text, validation_message, 'Ошибка датчика')
         ELSE ROUND(temperature::numeric, 1)::text || ' Вт/м²' END AS "sensor_33_text",
    CASE WHEN now() - "time" > interval '30 seconds' THEN -1
         WHEN valid = false THEN -1
         ELSE color_level END AS "sensor_33_color",
    COALESCE(sensor_name, 'Датчик 33') AS "sensor_33_Name",
    sensor_num AS "sensor_33_Number"
FROM public.sensor_measurements
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND sensor_used = true AND global_channel = 33
ORDER BY "time" DESC
LIMIT 1;
